items.text: mera abhi paisa nahi hai
thoda ruk jana
naukri gayi hai abhi
der ho jayegi
abhi nahi pay kar sakta

items.context: Payment ke liye kya plan hai?
items.text: kuch din ruk jayein

items.context: Aapko kis tarah ki madad chahiye?
items.text: thodi madad chahiye
main abhi unemployed hoon isliye paise nahi de pa raha
beemar tha is month ke bills pay nahi kar paya
meri job chali gayi us wajah se payment delay hai
mujhe thoda time chahiye apne financial halat sudharne ke liye
agar aap thoda ruk jaiye to main payment kar dunga
kya aap mere liye installment plan bana sakte hain
meri halat theek nahi hai is samay mujhe samay chahiye
kaam nahi mil raha isliye time chahiye payment ke liye
is mahine meri income nahi hui is wajah se thoda ruk jana
main phase me hoon par jald hi paise arrange kar lunga
meri tabiyat kharab hai is wajah se delay ho gaya payment mein
kya aap payment ka date badal sakte hain mujhe time chahiye
main abhi paise nahi de sakta kyunki job chhut gyi hai

items.context: Aap payment kyun nahi kar pa rahe?
items.text: meri job chhut gayi hai abhi kaam nahi mil raha
main kuch health problem ke wajah se kaam nahi kar raha
thoda samay chahiye paise arrange karne ke liye

items.context: Kya aapko financial problem ho rahi hai?
items.text: mujhe yeh samajh nahi aata ki main ab kya karun payment ke liye

items.context: Hum aapki madad kar sakte hain kya?
items.text: agar aap thoda time de to main paisa jama kara dunga
mujhe dukh hai ki main payment abhi nahi kar sakta kyunki meri job chhut gayi hai aur mera koi source of income abhi nahi hai
main beemar tha aur hospital me admit tha isi wajah se mera wo paisa jo main deposit karta tha wo abhi available nahi hai mujhe samajh hai ki payment delay ho gaya
mera hal aisa hai ki mera kaam band ho gaya hai lockdown ki wajah se aur main abhi tak paisa jama nahi kar paya isiliye thoda samay chahiye payment karne ke liye

items.context: Kya aap apni financial situation ke baare mein kuch batayenge?
items.text: meri job chhut gayi hai toh main abhi paise arrange nahi kar pa raha hoon main request karta hoon ki thoda samay de diya jaye

items.context: Aap payment kyu nahi kar pa rahe hain?
items.text: kuch makkhan beemari ki wajah se main hospital mein tha aur mujhe us wajah se kai bills clear nahi kar paya abhi bhi haalath thik nahi hai isliye payment delay ho raha hai

items.context: Aapko payment mein samasya kis wajah se ho rahi hai?
items.text: mere paas abhi jyada paisa nahi hai kyunki kuch dino se main kaam nahi kar pa raha hoon isliye mein aapse request karta hoon ki thoda time diya jaye payment karne ke liye

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: financial_hardship - explains they cannot pay right now because of job loss, illness or similar
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
